section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analysis methods used in a study examining the factor structure of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in a sample of Black college women. The study employed descriptive statistics, independent samples t-tests, Pearson correlations, exploratory and confirmatory factor analyses, and mediation analyses using bootstrapping procedures. Table 1 presents descriptive statistics (means and standard deviations) for multiple measures including BAS, ethnic identity, body self-relations, self-esteem, appearance attitudes, eating disorder symptoms, and appearance-related teasing.
